post.title: Why do web apps render fast but feel frozen when you click? | The Hydration Gap
post.subtitle:
Why do modern web applications render pixels instantly, yet feel completely frozen when you try to click a button? 🛠️

Learn how to master Why Modern Apps Feel Slow: The Hydration Gap in this quick breakdown.

📖 Read the full guide here:
https://www.abstractalgorithms.dev/

In this Short:
- Why do web apps render fast but feel frozen when you click?
- SSR paints static HTML instantly, but event listeners are missing.
- Downloading and parsing JS to attach listeners creates the hydration gap.
- Streaming SSR and resumability hydrate components lazily on demand.
- Full guide in description. Subscribe for more software engineering guides!
